provenance: Synthetic. robots.txt allows every crawler and the browser control is served. The edge answers GPTBot, ClaudeBot and ChatGPT-User with a plain 403 from Cloudflare (server: cloudflare, no error code, no challenge header), refuses the tagged Googlebot canary the same way, and serves OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Claude-SearchBot. The canary alone cannot tell a user-agent rule from IP verification; the crawlers served from the same address can, so the worker reads the refusals as user-agent rules, witnessed by OAI-SearchBot. Before the witness rule (CC-12d) this shape was the unverified one.
